## 2 · Research Focus {.pt-2}

*Quantifying Aboveground Biomass of California's Grasslands using Multi-Sensor Fusion and Machine Learning*

My current work integrates Sentinel-2 optical data, Sentinel-1 SAR, and ALOS PALSAR with machine learning algorithms like Random Forest and Neural Networks to build predictive models of aboveground biomass in California’s grasslands. Funded by UCSB’s Earth Research Institute, this project advances remote sensing approaches that support carbon accounting and agricultural management.
